phrases.latin: Ā quotā crepīdine trāmen abscēdit? — Ā crepīdine quārtā, in orbitā decimā.
phrases.english: From which platform does the train leave? — From platform 4, on track 10.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 211, 217.

Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
